All 9 pass on tt_2 in 1.0s: 6 parametrized blend-equivalence cases (iso_smooth → giant_thin covariance regimes, all >= 60 dB cpu vs cpu_cpp_mb), 2 full-pipeline parity tests (single + multi thin close-zoom Gaussians, both >= 35-50 dB cpu vs cpu_cpp), 1 anti-overdraw test (<1% nonzero pixels from a single ill-conditioned splat). fixes_landed.summary: Changed default max_radius from -1 (disabled) to 0 (auto = min(H,W)/2) in gsplat/rasterization.py:project_gaussians, gsplat/pipeline.py:Pipeline, backends/cpu_cpp/backend.py. The C++ project_full_fused contract (-1=off, 0=auto, >0=pixel cap) was already correct; only Python defaults needed flipping. Restored 30/30 views rendering meaningful content (was 25/30 black, 2/30 smudge, 3/30 blob).

scripts/render_30frame.py was reading scene.contrib_floor from cameras_v2.json but never passing it to Pipeline() — silently ignored. Fixed: Pipeline(backend, tile_size=32, contrib_floor=contrib_floor).
